notes.title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367690/Tony_Stewarts_AllAmerican_Racing/]Tony Stewart's All-American Racing[/url]![/i]

Built in collaboration with 3 time NASCAR Cup Series Champion Tony Stewart, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367690/Tony_Stewarts_AllAmerican_Racing/]All-American Racing[/url] features an all-new physics engine with US Legend Cars, Street Stocks, and Big-Block Modifieds along with 26 new dirt tracks and a totally revamped Career Mode, coming THIS Friday, September 4!

notes.title: Patch Notes June 11, 2020
notes.content:
We released a new patch for [i]Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing[/i] today. Changes include:

[list]
[*]Adjusted tuning of driving aids.
[*]If you have all driving aids disabled, when you create a Multiplayer lobby you can choose to allow or prohibit players using driving aids.
[/list]

notes.title: Celebrate Memorial Day at Matterhorn Motorsports Park!
notes.content:
Celebrate this Memorial Day Weekend at a new track, Matterhorn Motorsports Park!

Today's update to Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing adds this track to the game, for free. Matterhorn Motorsports Park is a unique course for you to enjoy in Quick Race, Split Screen, and Online Multiplayer modes.

notes.title: Knoxville Raceway DLC
notes.content: We're excited to announce the addition of Knoxville Raceway to Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing!!! This DLC will be available for purchase on April 29th. We can't wait to see you out on the track!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi,

We released a new patch for [i]Tony Stewart's Sprint Car[/i] Racing today. This patch includes these changes:

[list]
[*] Gameplay: Fixed AI at Desert Springs
[*] Gameplay: Added option to control amount of visual car shake effect 
[*] Gameplay: Green Flag banner remains on screen for much shorter duration in split-screen
[*] Gameplay: Increased maximum final gear in garage
[*] UI: Users can skip multiplayer point tally countup animation
[*] UI: Fixed potential crash bug in multiplayer lobbies
[*] UI: Prevented practice bonus money text from wrapping in practice summary
[*] Career: Fixed issue where newly-purchased parts occasionally had damage
[*] Other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: The Road Course Pack
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce the Road Course Pack, our first DLC pack for Tony Stewart’s Sprint Car Racing featuring 2 very unique tracks, and 3 additional paint schemes for each series. The pack will be available Friday, March 6th!

These tracks were custom built to really showcase the FUN of driving these high horsepower sprint cars! With a balance of technical turns, fast straights, and even some wild undulation, we think you’re really going to enjoy these new layouts in Quick Race, as well as Online. And, with three additional paint schemes to choose from per series… we know you’ll be looking good out there!
